correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the Gram operator in the uniform ambient inner product. Rescaling coordinates and a nonzero level preserves its spectrum. Counting remaining nonzero summands gives (m^r+m(-1)^r)/q at sum zero and (m^r-(-1)^r)/q otherwise. At level zero the two-coordinate exceptional term is supported on v=-u; character orthogonality yields same-character off-diagonal entries cχ(-1), with identity on-coordinate blocks and the constant decoupled. The symmetric and contrast directions give the claimed multiplicities. In d=3, |c|=1/(m-1); in d=4, |c|=1/(m²-m+1); in d≥5, (d-1)|c|<1. Applying the available character parities gives nullities 2, 1 and 2 at (3,3), (3,4) and (4,3), respectively. Both parities occur for odd q≥5, giving exactly the claimed ratio of Gram extremes (the squared synthesis condition number). At nonzero level, the one-coordinate mass changes only at u=1 and the pair exceptional term is supported on v=1-u. Splitting each mean-zero coordinate space into the evaluation direction η at 1 and the vanishing-at-1 subspace gives the two reflection parities (one fixed point in odd characteristic and none in even characteristic). On η the projected reflection has eigenvalue 1/m, giving off-diagonal e/N; the constant coupling is -e√(m-1)/N per coordinate. This recovers B and the coordinate contrasts. The vanishing-at-1 space is absent at q=3, and the plus reflection parity is absent at (4,3), excluding the possible small-case zeros outside B. In B the determinant reduces to m[mC²+eC(d-m-1)-(d-1)]/N². At d=3 the bracket is (m-1)(m²-2)-2, zero exactly at m=2. For d≥4, C≥d-1 and mC-|d-m-1|>1, so the determinant is strictly positive. The displayed eigenvalues exhaust the dimension; their shifts from 1 are uniformly O_q(d/m^{d-1}), including those of B by its operator norm after subtracting I. The proof covers all admissible fields and dimensions without any finite computation assumption.
residual_risks: The 44 reported full-spectrum comparisons are floating-point finite corroboration, not a fresh run, independent formal verification, or evidence for all dimensions.
